base_note: Built from the v31 candidate tree, not from an older branch. v31's Sticky for User, oEmbed FAQ entry, Personalization station and flosc.php work are all carried forward unchanged.

what_v32_adds.one_line: Variables in the personality designer: a floscAdmin can type {flow_name} or {score} into any aspect card and it becomes the value when the personality is sent to the model.
what_v32_adds.why: Typing a token used to send the literal seven characters. It matters most on a cross-domain flow, where a personality that says 'this site' names nothing.
what_v32_adds.expansion: On the request copy, every turn, because the attached personality can be switched mid-session and the next turn must read the new one. The stored ai_base_prompt keeps the tokens the floscAdmin wrote.
what_v32_adds.no_extra_queries: flosc_personality_variable_context() maps the evaluation context the chatpack and dispatch already assembled. The four tokens naming the visitor share one get_userdata(), cached, and only when the document contains one of them.
what_v32_adds.fast_exit: A document with no brace returns before any work. Only recognised tokens actually present are resolved. A floscAdmin's own braces are left alone.
what_v32_adds.safety: A value is prompt text, not markup, so escaping is not the protection that matters: braces are stripped so a value cannot introduce a token, control characters are stripped, length is capped at 500.
what_v32_adds.unresolved: An unresolved token substitutes empty. The literal reaching a model is the failure mode that once put "I'm {personality_name}" in front of a visitor.
what_v32_adds.designer: A Variables panel above the output pane lists every token with what it resolves to for the flow being edited. Visitor tokens say they resolve at chat time rather than showing a value invented for a screen where no visitor exists. Reuses the existing flosc-acc-var-chip styling — no new CSS.

v31_gate_fixed: test_candidate_contract.php was RED in v31. It pins the follow-up chatpack call by exact string, and v31 added a third argument to build_identity_section() for Sticky for User without updating it. v32 matches up to the comma. What the gate asserts — compact false, the whole profile every turn — is unchanged.
